description: ETLocal is the Quintel ETM Dataset Manager for building transparent present-day energy-system starting points. It lets users prepare or customise data for countries, provinces, municipalities, districts and neighbourhoods before using those datasets in the Energy Transition Model. Inputs are local energy, asset and demand information plus the ETM dataset schema; outputs are consistent baseline datasets for subsequent energy scenarios. Geographic coverage is a user-selected administrative area. MIT source and database setup instructions are public. The README says a Mapbox API key is needed for the local map view, but the repository can be inspected without one. A limitation is that a stable baseline still depends on the quality and consistency of local statistics; ETLocal is not an independent dispatch solver. It can support municipal energy-infrastructure scenario preparation. The related catalogue PyPSA model is a distinct power-system simulator, not ETLocal's downstream ETM. No key, input dataset or package was used.
